meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 用户要求把单个文档变成幻灯片时，Claude 会先确认源文档内容足够撑起一整套演示，然后调用 notebooklm 生成带 kawaii 角色的 16:9 幻灯片 PDF，再上传服务器取回 9:16 手机分享链接；本地也保留 PDF 文件。
howto.when: 当你说‘Wowerpoint 这个文件’、‘把这份报告变成幻灯片’等话，或要求把一个文档做成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片。

say.note: 另一种触发方式，效果相同。

say.text: 给这个文件做一版 kawaii 幻灯片。
say.note: 默认用可爱角色讲故事。

howto.what_en: When asked to turn one document into a slide deck, Claude verifies it, runs notebooklm to make a kawaii 16:9 PDF, uploads it for a 9:16 share URL, and also keeps the local PDF.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests like "Wowerpoint <file>", "turn this report into slides", or making a narrative deck from one document.

say_en.text: Make a kawaii slide deck for this file.
say_en.note: Uses the default kawaii storyteller prompt.
